name: dobe_idle_key5
refs: character design, front view: very broad chest, soft glossy goo body
eye style: human-like eye with yellow iris and dark round pupil, half-lidded, sly
desc: Pixel art game sprite, 256x256, of a huge soft paint goo monster shaped like a Doberman, three-quarter view facing left, standing idle. Tall pointed ears, simple smooth rounded muzzle without realistic snout lines, small head on a thick neck. Human-like eyes: yellow iris with a dark round pupil, half-lidded, sly smug smirk, drool dripping. VERY broad wide chest with big soft round pecs. The body is soft, squishy and melting like thick glossy slime: smooth rounded blobs, almost no interior muscle lines, goo sagging and dripping everywhere, lower body melts into a wide goo puddle. Glossy hot pink with soft flowing yellow marble streaks, large wet highlights, dark outline only around the silhouette.
